messages:
elaine-security: Auditor wants a compact evidence package that ties incident artifacts to SOC2/ISO controls. Need to prove: who exported, which KMS key wrapped data, manifest with hashes, and approval trace for manual exports.

sam-sre: Are we covering automated daily dumps too or only manual incident bundles?

elaine-security: Both. Auditor asked for one manual example (with approval) and one automated snapshot. They also want retention policy and KMS rotation proof.

maria-eng: Our automated exporter writes nightly to s3://redwood-evidence/auto/YYYY-MM-DD/export.tar.gz. CMK alias is alias/redwood-evidence-prod. Manifest and signature are next to the bundle: export-manifest.json + export.manifest.sig.

sam-sre: Retention: hot logs 90 days, archival evidence (Glacier) 3 years. SIEM searchable events 1 year. Lifecycle rule transitions at 14 days for evidence buckets.

auditor-kevin: For the manual export please include the approval ticket (redacted), cloudtrail events showing AssumeRole/StartExport, and the manifest with sha256 checksums. Also need the KMS key ARN and rotation log.

elaine-security: Example manifest (will redact values in shared copy):

```
{
  "bundle_id": "bundle-2026-02-11-01",
  "exported_by": "svc-evidence-exporter@redwood",
  "triggered_by": "alice-oncall",
  "trigger_type": "manual",
  "time_utc": "2026-02-11T01:03:22Z",
  "files": [
    {"s3_path": "s3://redwood-evidence/manual/bundle-2026-02-11/syslog-20260211.tar.gz", "sha256": "e3b0c442..."},
    {"s3_path": "s3://redwood-evidence/manual/bundle-2026-02-11/trace-export.ndjson", "sha256": "a7f1d2c3..."}
  ],
  "kms": {"key_arn": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd-ef01", "alias": "alias/redwood-evidence-prod"},
  "manifest_signature": "MEUCIQCi...",
  "signer_cert": "-----BEGIN CERT..."
}
```

maria-eng: We sign manifests with our HSM-backed key (EKM). The signer cert chain is exportable for auditor verification. We can also show the KMS DescribeKey and rotation events.

sam-sre: For identity trail: cloudtrail shows sts:AssumeRole (role:svc-evidence-exporter) and iam:CreatePresignedUrl for customer uploads. We can pull the exact event ids for the sample.

auditor-kevin: For Private (customer-managed keys), how do you prove encryption in transit to customer bucket? Need to see the envelope key header or the wrapped DEK blob and the CMK id.

maria-eng: Private deployments: exporter either uploads directly to a pre-authorized customer bucket (customer CMK) or returns an encrypted envelope to the customer's SFTP. Manifest will include wrapped_dek_b64 and wrapping_key_id (customer CMK id). We can redact customer PII.

opsbot: export job started id=0x1a2b by svc-evidence-exporter at 2026-02-11T01:03:22Z

sam-sre: Vulnerability triage evidence: we store triage records in s3://redwood-vuln-triage/{year}/ticket-{id}/ with files: triage.json (includes git_commit, image_digest, sbom_path). Example triage.json snippet is fine to include.

elaine-security: Auditor wants proof that CI signs commits and that PR approvals are recorded. Can we include a Buildkite link + signed commit and the PR merge metadata?

maria-eng: Yes. We can include a CI run URL, the commit sha with gpg signature, and the PR approval history from GitHub (redacted). Image registry holds image manifest and digest and a provenance file with SBOM + signature.

auditor-kevin: OK please bundle: (1) manual export manifest + signature + redacted approval ticket + cloudtrail entries; (2) automated export manifest + lifecycle policy + KMS rotation record; (3) vuln triage bundle with git commit, PR approvals, CI run link, image digest and SBOM; (4) README mapping each artifact to SOC2/ISO control IDs and the exact query used to get logs.

elaine-security: Action items: Maria: assemble bundle A (manual + automated) and expose via presigned URL. Sam: retrieve cloudtrail snippets and lifecycle policy JSON. I'll produce control mapping doc linking artifacts to controls CC6.1/CC6.2/CC6.5 / ISO A.9/A.12.

maria-eng: Uploading artifacts to temp evidence bucket now, presigned links emailed to auditor-kevin. Included manifest, signature, kms-describe output, rotation history, redacted ticket, and vuln triage sample. ETA 3 hours.

opsbot: export job id=0x1a2b status=completed exit=0 duration=00:00:14 artifacts=5 manifest=s3://redwood-evidence/manual/bundle-2026-02-11/export-manifest.json

auditor-kevin: Received the link, starting review. Please ensure README lists the exact CLI/cloud queries used to create each file. I'll verify sha256s.

elaine-security: Will update the mapping doc and send to auditor channel when finalized. Also logged follow-up: add console 'signed evidence export' feature ticket as PLAT-1210.

sam-sre: Noted. This will reduce manual overhead for future audits.

auditor-kevin: Thanks everyone. If I need anything else I'll post here. :thumbsup:
